name: Walk speed, gravity and fly limits
summary: Set how fast you walk and run, how heavy gravity is, how high you jump and how fast you can fly. The edges of your view darken a little when you go fast, to keep you comfortable.
helps: Move through a big scene quickly or float like the moon, without feeling sick.
where2d: Atelier and BSA, right panel, Settings: Walk settings.

d2: Open the right panel and find Settings.
Press Player Speed, Player Gravity, Run, Fly speed cap or Jump height to step through the choices.
vr: Open the wrist menu and press Settings, then Walk settings.
Press Player Speed to step through the speeds.
Press Player Gravity. Zero floats you, 9.81 is Earth.
use: speed goes from 0 to 45 metres a second
gravity goes from 0 to 9.81, and 0 floats you
the view edges darken only when you go faster than walking, and never flicker
when you fly you pass through walls but not the floor

changes.note: You can now set your walking speed, gravity, jump height and fly speed, and the view edges soften when you go fast, so open Settings and press Walk settings.
